claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Enalapril is a non-cytotoxic ACE inhibitor prodrug that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent antiproliferative signal would be weak and non-selective rather than a genuine cytotoxic mechanism.
